newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE sharpens gains amid tight prompt supply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE sharpens gains amid tight prompt supply.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices rose sharply again this week amid continued tight supply of prompt barrels and demand largely by blenders, players said on Tuesday.
Meanwhile, traders predicted the strong pricing to remain as far out as August due to talk several plants may come down this month for turnaround.
"All of July seems pretty strong. We don't see any significant backwardation until August, which is in the low 80s," said a U.S. Gulf Coast trader.
Traders said the 15,000 barrel-per-day Belvieu Environmental Fuels plant in Texas is expected to come down for turnaround later in July as well as Enron's 15,000-17,000 bpd facility.
The talk could not be immediately confirmed.
"We are anticipating Enron to shut down in July for a catalyst change but they could delay because the market is so strong," said a trader.

The turnarounds would help drain what is already a shallow pool of prompt MTBE supply due to plant shutdowns in May and earlier in June. The latest of plant glitches occurred last week, when Global Octane shut its 12,500 bpd plant in Deer Park, Texas, for unexpected maintenance.
The plant returned on line Monday, sources said.

Meanwhile, spot barrels of MTBE from ARCO's Rotterdam plant are not expected to reach the U.S. spot market until August. The plant, which was expected to have come up by today, has already sold its first shipment of material to a Canadian player, a source said.

"The first ships are sold and most of it is staying up in Canada. The first barrels available in the U.S. spot market probably won't arrive until August," said the source familiar with the ARCO plant.

In the U.S. Gulf Coast, spot MTBE rose about 2.50 cents from Friday to 87.25 cents a gallon and 87.50 cents a gallon on Tuesday. On Monday, an 88.00-cent deal for 10,000 barrels was done. New York Harbor spot MTBE was up about a cent at
88.00/89.00 cents. -- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631--
